brandPositioningSummary: Sheraton is an owner-facing full-service Sheraton with legacy repositioning potential within Marriott International. Underwrite the asset against this brand's guest promise, product scope, and operating complexity rather than sibling brands or corporate platform averages.
audienceSummary: Sheraton targets guests aligned with Bleisure, Group / MICE, International Inbound. Evaluate demand behavior in each target market rather than generic chain-loyalty averages or parent-platform assumptions.
ownerFitSummary: Sheraton should be chosen when the asset can deliver this positioning more credibly than Marriott Hotels, Westin, Four Points by Sheraton, and Four Points Flex by Sheraton. Assess whether demand mix, product scope, and operating complexity favor Sheraton over adjacent Marriott alternatives in the same tier and geography.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Legacy Full-Service Repositioning
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Sheraton creates owner value on legacy full-service hotels where lobby, meetings, and rooms can be refreshed into a contemporary Sheraton story without collapsing into Four Points select-service or Flex midscale conversion logic.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Meetings And Social Space Reactivation
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Assets with underused ballrooms and social public space fit Sheraton when owners capitalize reactivation honestly—staffing, F&B, and PIP must match group demand rather than cosmetic lobby work alone.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Resort And Gateway Network Play
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Resort and gateway Sheraton sites gain from Bonvoy reach when product and service stay full-service. Owners should compare Westin wellness and Marriott Hotels flagship lanes before assuming Sheraton is interchangeable.

valueCreationScenarios.title: Conversion With Brand-Legible Public Space
valueCreationScenarios.summary: Conversions work when arrival, lobby, and meetings areas become unmistakably Sheraton. Value erodes if the PIP leaves a generic midscale box that guests read as Four Points or Flex.

scenarios.title: Legacy Full-Service Reinvestment
scenarios.summary: Sheraton creates owner value when sponsors reinvest in capable full-service shells—especially where meetings and social public space can be modernized into a credible brand experience. Underwrite PIP and operating intensity as full-service work, not select-service shortcuts. Keep Four Points by Sheraton and Four Points Flex out of the same underwriting lane.

scenarios.title: Community And Meetings Hub Positioning
scenarios.summary: Owner value strengthens when Sheraton affiliation supports local meetings, events, and bleisure demand the plant can host. Diligence banquet capacity, public-space programming, and operator depth before modeling lift. CALA resorts such as Cancún and Puerto Vallarta provide regional product references for full-service Sheraton delivery. Keep Sheraton product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the full-service Sheraton with legacy repositioning potential stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.

scenarios.title: Network Lift Without Select-Service Drift
scenarios.summary: Marriott Bonvoy distribution helps only when the hotel remains a true Sheraton, not a Flex-style conversion. Sequence standards, systems, and training so relaunch quality matches full-service expectations. Compare Marriott Hotels and Westin when the asset’s premium or wellness profile points elsewhere. Keep Sheraton product and service responsibilities clear among owner, operator, and brand teams so the full-service Sheraton with legacy repositioning potential stays deliverable after affiliation and through ongoing operations.
